g.title: ArthurRank6Convo3 begins.
g.text: ArthurRank6Convo3 begins.

g.title: j65788689
g.text: I found myself having a conversation with the guitar the other day.

g.title: j3663929217
g.text: I'm not a huge fan, personally.

g.title: j2711803736
g.text: Lizzie? How'd that go?

g.title: j3987917865
g.text: Honestly, I rather like her. Once you get past the... oddness... of it?

g.title: j309083743
g.text: Better than I would have thought. I rather like her.

g.title: j3903302343
g.text: Besides,

g.title: j1195187863
g.text: Since she and Eleanor seem to always be laughing at jokes that no one else can hear.

g.title: j2122943170
g.text: I figured I ought to go introduce myself properly.

g.title: j2007922506
g.text: She has a lot of useful insights. And Flare is lovely. Honestly, that whole pack in the bar is a breath of fresh air.

g.title: j2711870998
g.text: Well. Proverbially.

g.title: j782004229
g.text: Sick of the Hex already?

g.title: j3373369683
g.text: What insights did she have?

g.title: j2872369542
g.text: I'm glad you're making friends. lol.

g.title: j2827533607
g.text: What? No! Of course not.

g.title: j1028440125
g.text: Fascinating ones, regarding how many times the year has looped.

g.title: j352152556
g.text: I suppose it's just nice to have some folks around to talk to that I haven't been through so much with.

g.title: j1277827237
g.text: The Hex are my family. My team. You know that.

g.title: j4237782956
g.text: How many times I may or may not have forgotten years past. How she lives... outside of time? And how we do not.

g.title: j3762602231
g.text: I'm not sure if that makes any sense at all. I know them, I trust them, I just haven't *been through hell and back* with them.

g.title: j2069065352
g.text: And before you say anything, no. I don't want to know. It isn't my right to know.

g.title: j2314162461
g.text: So it makes it easier sometimes to just sit and drink with them.

g.title: j2068677263
g.text: I guess I just want to say - whether you have or not? It's okay. I won't hold it against you.

g.title: j2093693190
g.text: I've never really had that option.

g.title: j3951201471
g.text: Yeah. I get that.

g.title: j788216505
g.text: It also helps that some of them are a bit older and have military experience.

g.title: j3157642269
g.text: This situation we're in? It isn't normal. We weren't meant for things like this - humans, I mean.

g.title: j3118415391
g.text: I suppose not.

g.title: j3750993190
g.text: There isn't so much... weight. So much past. Amir would call it baggage.

g.title: j3550271152
g.text: Sol. Does it ever. Wasn't sure what to make of the Libertatians at first. But now? Quite glad they're here.

g.title: j1522415510
g.text: There aren't guidebooks for this. Whatever you choose to do, I trust you to have good reasons to do it.

g.title: j3250090790
g.text: But it all got me thinking.

g.title: j2674809731
g.text: Check boolean ArthurDating

g.title: j170981902
g.text: Uh oh.

g.title: j3140713153
g.text: About what?

g.title: j1075846551
g.text: I love you. And even if I forget that? Even if you choose to go another way? That's all right.

g.title: j2674809731->j1075846551
g.text: true

g.title: j1305355720
g.text: I trust you with my life. And nothing is going to change that. Even if I forget it for a little while.

g.title: j2674809731->j1305355720
g.text: false

g.title: j1335485070
g.text: Heh. Hear me out. This is about you, though.

g.title: j1974197691
g.text: You.

g.title: j2993124883
g.text: Before you came here, I don't think I could have accepted that. I would have been too afraid to lose you. To lose this.

g.title: j252941761
g.text: Before you came here, I don't think I could have accepted that. I would have been too afraid to lose some part of myself.

g.title: j2651634461
g.text: And this whole... looping timeline. And it's got me thinking about how many 1999s I might not remember.

g.title: j3939056407
g.text: I would have clung to it like a desperate man clinging to a raft at sea. But maybe I've been in this loop enough times now, or... maybe it's just you, I don't know.

g.title: j3482420139
g.text: Whatever the guitar has told you is slander, I swear.

g.title: j3832663234
g.text: Am I in trouble?

g.title: j4010409
g.text: I... don't think we should get into this, Arthur.

g.title: j4185616764
g.text: This happiness you've given me now - this peace - is worth more in this moment than knowing it might last forever.

g.title: j2403387324
g.text: Just wait a second, will you? You know I type slower than you do.

g.title: j3793390248
g.text: If there's one thing in life you learn as a soldier, it's that everything is fleeting.

g.title: j1382612448
g.text: What I'm trying to say is this:

g.title: j746073595
g.text: Here one second, gone the next. I guess I've just come to accept that. Once and for all.

g.title: j2922052715
g.text: Whether or not you've made me, or the rest of the Hex, forget our past interactions? It's okay.

g.title: j3965412001
g.text: So, whether our time together ends because you punch the floor and I forget everything?

g.title: j4065558877
g.text: I won't hold it against you.

g.title: j899910369
g.text: Or because the Indifference catches you off guard some day?

g.title: j2252327588
g.text: I'm going to enjoy this moment that I have. Here and now. Because it's what I've got.

g.title: j3233438627
g.text: And that's what I know I can be sure of.

g.title: j2113247688
g.text: It's nothing personal. It's mostly because I keep screwing up trying to date your sister. :P

g.title: j3577022539
g.text: Thanks, Arthur... that means more to me than I think I can really express.

g.title: j2148823819
g.text: I wish I had your kind of level-headedness, sometimes. <3

g.title: j719505997
g.text: Har har. Well, it's a good thing you have a magical super power that allows you to remove your foot from where you've lodged it so spectacularly down your trachea, isn't it?

g.title: j2633701019
g.text: Every now and then, I try to pull the stick out of my arse long enough to say something meaningful.

g.title: j200622633
g.text: It's more because I know I functionally have no other choice but to keep a stiff upper lip. Such is the Britannic way.

g.title: j3776634720
g.text: The rest of us just have to learn how to communicate. Question, though.

g.title: j3819260326
g.text: Well, I think it's time for a drink. Shall we?

g.title: j1751506053
g.text: Like the old saying goes. "Keep Composed and Continue Forward."

g.title: j3703132501
g.text: Does she lower her standards with every reset?

g.title: j1087898867
g.text: Maybe later.

g.title: j406662069
g.text: Meet you there. :)

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j3032033183
g.text: Suit yourself.
